author: nickyeow

english.text: My throat burns.

jyutping: ngo5 go3 hau4 lung4 hou2 ci5 bei2 fo2 siu1 gam2。
text: 我個喉嚨好似比火燒噉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: These old customs have been handed down from generation to generation.

jyutping: ni1 di1 gu2 lou5 ge3 zaap6 zuk6 dou1 hai6 jat1 doi6 jat1 doi6 gam2 cyun4 lok6 lai4 ge3。
text: 呢啲古老嘅習俗都係一代一代噉傳落嚟嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I miss you very much.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5。
text: 我好掛住你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You may not smoke in this room.

jyutping: ne1 gaan1 fong4 m4 bei2 sik6 jin1 gaa3。
text: 呢間房唔俾食煙㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Shall I ask Peter for help?

jyutping: ngo5 jing1 m4 jing1 goi1 wan2 aa3 Peter bong1 sau2 ne1？
text: 我應唔應該搵阿 Peter 幫手呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It was nice and cool, but it is getting cold now.

jyutping: cin4 gei2 jat6 zung6 hai6 hou2 loeng4、hou2 syu1 fuk6，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 zau6 hoi1 ci2 dung3 laa3。
text: 前幾日仲係好涼、好舒服，但係而家就開始凍喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will you look after my dog while I am away?
Will you look after my dog while I'm away?

jyutping: ngo5 zau2 zo2 go2 zan6，nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ziu3 gu3 ngo5 zek3 gau2 aa3？
text: 我走咗嗰陣，你可唔可以幫我照顧我隻狗呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm not a magician.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 mo1 seot6 si1。
text: 我唔係魔術師。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Leaving something unfinished is the worst thing you can do.

jyutping: mou5 mat1 je5 seoi1 dak1 gwo3 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3。
text: 冇乜嘢衰得過半途而廢。

author: richke

english.text: You show him some respect!

jyutping: nei5 bei2 di1 min6 keoi5 laa1！
text: 你畀啲面佢啦！

author: kaenif

english.text: What difference does it make if people are looking at us?

jyutping: di1 jan2 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 jau6 jau5 fan1 bit6 me1？
text: 啲人望住我哋又有分別咩？

author: kaenif

english.text: I told them to wear ties.

jyutping: ngo5 giu3 zo2 keoi5 dei6 daa2 taai1。
text: 我叫咗佢哋打呔。

author: kaenif

english.text: Where did you weigh them?

jyutping: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 cing3 gaa3？
text: 你喺邊度秤㗎？

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom owns a yellow sports car.

jyutping: Tom jau5 gaa3 wong4 sik1 paau2 ce1。
text: Tom有架黃色跑車。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you know why I'm angry all the time?

jyutping: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 niu5 aa3？
text: 你知唔知點解我成日都咁嬲呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you have any trouble finding the place?

jyutping: go2 dou3 naan4 m4 naan4 wan2 aa3？
text: 嗰到難唔難搵呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If something isn't done, this species will soon go extinct.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 zou6 di1 je5，ni1 zung2 sang1 mat6 zau6 wui6 zyut6 zung2 gaa3 laa3。
text: 如果我哋唔做啲嘢，呢種生物就會絕種㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I love his accent.
I love her accent.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5 go3 hau2 jam1。
text: 我好鍾意佢個口音。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Every language has its particularities.

jyutping: mui5 go3 jyu5 jin4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 duk6 dak6 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 每個語言都有自己獨特嘅地方。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Shut the fuck up!

jyutping: sau1 lan2 pei4 laa1 diu2！
text: 收撚皮啦屌！

author: aizilan

english.text: Watch out!
It's dangerous!

jyutping: ngai4 him2 aa1！
text: 危險呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is always at home on Mondays.

jyutping: keoi5 go3 go3 lai5 baai3 jat1 dou1 m4 ceot1 gaai1。
text: 佢個個禮拜一都唔出街。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: American cities are not as dense as European cities.

jyutping: mei5 gwok3 sing4 si5 mou4 au1 zau1 ge3 gam3 cau4 mat6。
text: 美國城市無歐州嘅咁稠密。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I don't think it's possible to finish that amount of work in one day.

jyutping: gam3 gwai2 do1 je5，ngo5 m4 gok3 dak1 jat1 jat6 zou6 dak1 saai3 lo1。
text: 咁鬼多嘢，我唔覺得一日做得曬囉。

english.text: Oh I say, now that is a winner right out of this world! Well, you won't see a better shot than this, hit after this marvelous lob from Jimmy Connors, who catches McEnroe moving forward – a classic moment for the lob – and McEnroe hesitates, realises he can't really hit the overhead cleanly – it's beaten him – chases it back and unleashes... a backhand such as you dream about.

jyutping: o2 ngo5 waa6，ji4 gaa1 go2 go3 hai6 ne1 go3 sai3 gaai3 ge3 jeng4 gaa1！ hou2 laa1，nei5 m4 wui5 gin3 dou3 bei2 ni1 go3 gang3 hou2 ge3 se6 mun4，hai2 gat1 mai5 · hong1 naap6 si1 ge3 ni1 go3 kei4 miu6 ge3 gou1 kau4 zi1 hau6 se6 jap6，keoi5 zuk1 zyu6 mak6 jan1 lo4 hoeng3 cin4 haang4 - ni1 go3 hai6 gou1 kau4 ge3 ging1 din2 si4 hak1 - ji4 mak6 jan1 lo4 jau4 jyu6 zo2，ji3 sik1 dou3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 gon1 zeng6 gam2 daa2 dou3 tau4 deng2 - keoi5 daa2 zo2 keoi5 – zeoi1 faan1 keoi5，jin4 hau6 sik1 fong3 ceot1 ... jat1 go3 hou2 ci5 nei5 mung6 soeng2 zung1 ge3 hau6 sau2。
text: 哦我話，而家嗰個係呢個世界嘅贏家！ 好啦，你唔會見到比呢個更好嘅射門，喺吉米 · 康納斯嘅呢個奇妙嘅高球之後射入，佢捉住麥恩羅向前行 - 呢個係高球嘅經典時刻 - 而麥恩羅猶豫咗，意識到佢真係唔可以乾淨噉打到頭頂 - 佢打咗佢 – 追返佢，然後釋放出 ... 一個好似你夢想中嘅後手。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 4th of March of 2015. Countries like Japan and Thailand have Animistic traditions alongside Buddhism. Religions in these countries are a colourful affair with much variety in thought. First baptized as a Roman Catholic baby in the Philippines, I was baptized a second time in Tokyo some point in 1992 to 1994, by an unknown religious organization. It was a full body immersion in water. I consider myself now as a spiritual person, but not religious. Spirituality is different from religion.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 4 hou6。hou2 ci5 jat6 bun2 tung4 taai3 gwok3 ni1 di1 gwok3 gaa1，ceoi4 zo2 fat6 gaau3 zi1 ngoi6，dou1 jau5 dung6 mat6 cyun4 tung2。ni1 di1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zung1 gaau3 hai6 jat1 gin6 sik1 coi2 ban1 fan1 ge3 si6，si1 soeng2 do1 joeng6 faa3。ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1 sau6 sai2，hai6 jat1 go3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 jing1 ji4，hai2 1992 nin4 zi3 1994 nin4 ge3 mau5 go3 si4 hau6，ngo5 hai2 dung1 ging1 sau6 zo2 dai6 ji6 ci3，hai6 jau4 jat1 go3 m4 ceot1 meng2 ge3 zung1 gaau3 zou2 zik1 sau6 sai2，ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jing6 wai4 zi6 gei2 hai6 jat1 go3 ling4 sing3 ge3 jan4，daan6 m4 hai6 zung1 gaau3。
text: 今日係2015年3月4號。好似日本同泰國呢啲國家，除咗佛教之外，都有動物傳統。呢啲國家嘅宗教係一件色彩繽紛嘅事，思想多樣化。我第一次喺菲律賓受洗，係一個羅馬天主教嬰兒，喺1992年至1994年嘅某個時候，我喺東京受咗第二次，係由一個唔出名嘅宗教組織受洗，我而家認為自己係一個靈性嘅人，但唔係宗教。

author: Gearhulk

english.text: Please go help Tom.

jyutping: cing2 nei5 heoi3 bong1 aa3 tong1 laa1。
text: 請你去幫阿湯啦。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Discouraged by the seemingly endless challenges of farming, Prem is increasingly focusing on his motorcycle repair business, which can earn him $5 to $10 per day if he is lucky. Still, he is determined not to give up the three cows left in his herd. “I care about them,” he said, “because they are part of my life.”

jyutping: jau4 jyu1 nung4 jip6 ge3 hon3 ci5 mou4 kung4 mou4 zeon6 ge3 tiu1 zin3，pou2 leoi4 mou5 hou2 fui1 sam1，keoi5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 zyun1 zyu3 hai2 keoi5 ge3 din6 daan1 ce1 wai4 sau1 saang1 ji3，jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 hou2 coi2，keoi5 mui5 jat6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou3 5 zi3 10 mei5 jyun4。jing4 jin4，keoi5 kyut3 sam1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3 keoi5 kwan4 jap6 min6 zing6 dai1 ge3 saam1 zek3 ngau4。「ngo5 gwaan1 sam1 keoi5 dei6，」keoi5 waa6，「jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngo5 sang1 wut6 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6。」
text: 由於農業嘅看似無窮無盡嘅挑戰，普雷姆好灰心，佢越嚟越專注喺佢嘅電單車維修生意，如果佢好彩，佢每日可以賺到5至10美元。仍然，佢決心唔會放棄佢群入面剩低嘅三隻牛。「我關心佢哋，」佢話，「因為佢哋係我生活嘅一部分。」
